about: Photo and signature requirements copied from official exam documents. Every exam needs a source URL, where in the document the numbers are, and the date we read it. Never add a requirement that is not in an official document. Requirements change between exam cycles, so each entry names the cycle it was read from.

exams.name: IBPS PO/MT (CRP PO/MT-XV)
exams.cycle: CRP PO/MT-XV, vacancies of 2026-27 (registration dates in the document: 01.07.2025 to 21.07.2025)

source.title: Notification CRP PO/MT-XV, Annexure III: Guidelines for Scanning and Upload of Documents

notes: IBPS marks the pixel sizes as preferred, and the file sizes as the limits to meet.
The document states the file type as jpg/jpeg for the thumb impression and the declaration. It does not state it for the photograph and signature; this tool always makes JPG.
A live photograph is also captured in the application itself, separate from this upload.

documents.name: Signature
documents.note: Sign on white paper with a black pen. A signature in capital letters is not accepted.

documents.name: Left thumb impression
documents.note: Use black or blue ink on white paper.

documents.name: Handwritten declaration
documents.note: It must be in your own handwriting, in English, and not in capital letters.

exams.name: SSC CGL 2026
exams.cycle: Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026 (online applications until 22.06.2026)

source.title: Notice of the Combined Graduate Level Examination, 2026

notes: In this notice the photograph is captured with the camera inside the application form, so there is no photo file to upload.
The notice gives the signature size in centimetres only, with no pixel size, so this tool keeps your image's pixel size and only fits the file size.

documents.name: Signature
documents.note: Blurred or miniature signatures are rejected.
